topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I just got a call from my best friend, and I can't quite put my finger on why I'm feeling this way. They said the venue for the party they had been planning for me has some unexpected maintenance issues, and they had to cancel everything. They were quick to assure me they're already looking into alternative options and that it's just a temporary setback. I keep thinking about all the effort they've put in and, honestly, I can't help but feel a bit overwhelmed by the whole situation. I should be happy they're trying to make it up to me, but I just can't shake this lingering sense of... I don't even know what it is. I guess I'll just have to wait and see what happens next.
